1.name: Origin
1.ov: With the most charismatic leader, Santiago Bernabéu, the golden age of the club began. The creation of the most important competition in Europe, the Champions League, provided the club more competitive football. The streak of 5 consecutive wins began their glory. New generations have achieved 4 more titles in 5 years. The most important: The tenth.

1.name: Reach
1.ov: For their great triumphs in the Champions League, Real Madrid is known worldwide. Alfredo Di Stéfano, one of the best players in the world, exemplifies the essence of the club. Passes, goals, plays. Witnesses and players build a profile of Di Stéfano and compare his third European Cup triumph with the most recent successes of the club.

1.name: The Human Factor
1.ov: The legacy of achievement and not giving up are part of the DNA of the Real Madrid players, a DNA transmitted from generation to generation. The most important leaders meet to understand what it means to be and have been part of the club. Anecdotes about what happens in the locker room and how they prepare to overcome any adversary.

1.name: The Spirit of the Quinta
1.ov: Amancio Amaro, soccer coach of the Real Madrid junior team, had in his hands 5 of the most important future professional players. They went down in history for their courage, grit and competitive spirit. 40 years later they come together to remember the years of La Quinta del Buitre.

1.name: Renaissance
1.ov: The last European Cup achieved by Real Madrid was its 6th. Only Spanish players participated in that final. 32 years passed before Real Madrid could think about winning another European Cup. Those players of the 1998 team tell us how they achieved that victory. A victory that would change the course of Real Madrid forever.

1.name: Eternity
1.ov: The final game of the 5th European Cup is considered the best match in the history of the competition. One player goes down in history with 4 goals: Puskas. With this victory, Real Madrid laid the foundations of its legend and has built its future. Today they stand at the gates of a new stadium, reaching new challenges as a club, with the fans and lovers of the beautiful game.
